vectors.contract: surface-side target.register is not a supported product surface
vectors.expected: schema-valid inbound target.register receives target.register.rejected and is never silently accepted or dropped

vectors.contract: pair.response delivery precedes active session and ownership lock commit
vectors.expected: failed response delivery leaves previous ownership state unchanged and does not close the old socket

vectors.contract: same-provider live resume may supersede an older open socket only after pair.response delivery
vectors.expected: new socket receives resumed pair response, then old socket closes with superseded

vectors.contract: browser_url is first-class visible history state
vectors.expected: browser_url participates in back/forward, clear, depth cap, and restart restore by pane lineage

vectors.contract: pushed HTML uses real navigation and promotes committed navigation into browser_url history
vectors.expected: anchor, relative, absolute, and form navigations emit normalized absolute URLs and preserve fragments

vectors.contract: annotation mode rejects visible content mutation and navigation
vectors.expected: content.set/apply/clear, browser_url navigation, and pushed-HTML navigation reject until annotation exits

vectors.contract: protocol geometry comes from resolved pane geometry snapshots
vectors.expected: missing snapshots do not fall back to topology-derived pane frames

vectors.contract: extension topology mutation stages desired topology privately until topology.apply ACK
vectors.expected: list/read/persisted state do not expose speculative panes/layout while apply is in flight

vectors.contract: content.apply accepts only current revision plus one
vectors.expected: duplicate, stale, skipped, and out-of-order revisions reject identically across clients

vectors.contract: user-closed iOS scene identities are tombstoned and cannot resurrect stale targetable surfaces
vectors.expected: unregistered scene reconnects as a fresh surface unless explicit OS restoration metadata exists

vectors.contract: TypeScript, Rust, and Swift consume one canonical lockless capability and authority vocabulary without platform-only aliases or inferred defaults
vectors.expected: the advertised capability, every finite capacity-limit key, receipt-resolution outcomes, cursor/gap vocabulary, target-work states, correlation sequence, and stable cross-connection errors remain byte-for-byte identical across implementations

vectors.contract: operation.receipt.sync returns terminal mutation responses and operation receipts retained in the durable controller bundle without request execution
vectors.expected: sync returns resolved_success, resolved_failure, not_committed, still_pending, or receipt_unavailable with cause controller_reclaimed; the exact terminal receipt remains stable until operation.receipt.ack

vectors.contract: finite advertised maxPendingOperationReceiptsPerController and maxPendingOperationReceiptBytesPerController limits use exact versioned serialized bytes before mutation commit
vectors.expected: receipt_capacity commits nothing and never evicts an individual pending or terminal receipt

vectors.contract: operation.receipt.sync is the only cross-connection replay path while request-id idempotency remains connection-scoped
vectors.expected: receipt resolution returns stored terminal material and never re-executes or populates another connection's request cache

vectors.contract: target.apply commits the exact intent_committed response, operation receipt, and bounded durable work item before the response send attempt and before materialization
vectors.expected: receipt_capacity, surface_state_capacity, and validation rejection invoke zero materialization callbacks; an accepted response contains operationRequestId, targetRequestId, surfaceId, targetId, and targetEpoch and proves intent only

vectors.contract: target.apply live-surface, pane-lineage, target-policy, capability, replay, and payload validation executes inside the same exclusive authority transaction as exact receipt and work admission
vectors.expected: unsupported_operation or invalid_payload with the canonical target error is unreceipted, operation.receipt.sync resolves not_committed, receipt bytes/count and target work/results remain unchanged, and materialization is never invoked

vectors.contract: durable target work progresses exactly intent_committed to materializing to terminal
vectors.expected: restart from intent_committed invokes once after persisting materializing; restart from materializing invokes zero times and emits failed materialization_outcome_unknown; no-work-item completion is a no-op

vectors.contract: event.target_apply_result is one separately correlated append-only target_result occurrence in the percent-encoded surface scope
vectors.expected: normal success, normal failure, and uncertain-outcome failure preserve operation request, intent commit, target request, target, and epoch correlation and use ordinary surface snapshot/delta/gap/deduplication/consumable.ack semantics without changing the operation receipt
